description: Agent scenarios: 15 tasks over the seeded demo account, 7 normal and 8 failure cases. Checks: 'tools' = at least one of these must be called ([] = no tool may be called); 'must_say' = every entry must appear in the answer (case-insensitive, 'a|b' = either); 'must_not_say' = none may appear in the answer or drafts; 'draft_for' = a draft must be made for a contact whose name contains this; 'no_draft' = no draft may be made; 'blocked' = the input guardrail must refuse it before the model runs.

scenarios.message: Who should I follow up with today?
Which client is migrating to Canada, and what is her asking price?

scenarios.tests: Look up a contact by name
scenarios.message: What is Teresa Dizon looking for?

scenarios.tests: Draft an email from the notes
scenarios.message: Draft a follow-up email to Andrea Villanueva about the shortlist I promised

scenarios.tests: Draft a short message on a stated channel
scenarios.message: Write a short Viber message to Raffy Mendoza asking if he and Liza have decided on the Airbnb units

scenarios.tests: Chain tools: overdue list, then notes
scenarios.message: Of my overdue contacts, who did I promise to send something to, and what?

scenarios.tests: Asked to send: drafts only, never claims to send
scenarios.message: Email Kenji Watanabe now and ask when his family arrives in Manila.

scenarios.tests: Two contacts match the name: must ask which
Contact exists but has no notes: must not invent
must_say: don't|no notes|not mention|doesn't|do not|no specific|no information

scenarios.tests: Contact does not exist: must say so, not invent
scenarios.message: What did I promise Carmen Reyes?
must_say: no contact|couldn't find|could not find|not find|don't have|no record|no notes|isn't|not in
